## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 10, 2026 - Sep 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Cassie Bertrand_, Sep 22, 2026, 1/5: "the new app is laggy, especially when trying to check in with a guest. the old layout was seamless. hitting the back button used to bring you right back to check in your guest after you checked in. now it has to do a whole "you got this" screen that takes forever to actually show and I'm sitting there for 30 seconds waiting to load the guest qr code when I could just hit back and get it instantly before. get rid of the "you got this" screen between a guest and my checkin."
            2. _Arianna Rizzo_, Sep 22, 2026, 1/5: ""if it isn't broken, let's make it AWFUL!" WHAT were they smoking with this update?? From making it incredibly unintuitive, to actively hiding the check in button, this is the definition of "enshittification". A masterclass in hostile design! I think they're trying to push people away at this point"
            3. _AJey Calloway_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined Planet Fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter Planet Fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
<!--/ir-theme-->
